summary: This bill establishes a 5-year pilot program for the Department of Homeland Security to test and assess new technologies, including artificial intelligence and machine learning, to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of cargo inspections at land ports of entry along U.S. borders, aiming to detect contraband, illegal drugs, weapons, and human smuggling.

scores.thoughts: This bill establishes a pilot program to test new technologies at land ports of entry to detect contraband, illegal drugs, illegal weapons, and human smuggling. While it doesn't directly address immigration policy, its focus on enhancing border inspection processes for human smuggling contributes to securing borders.
